title: 第2章 呆呆傻傻有点嘎-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    砰！砰！砰——

    急促的敲门声在耳边响起，接着一个男人催促的声音透过门传了过来，“靓仔，你在干嘛？全剧组的人都在等你。”

    而被催促的魏沐，却无力地瘫坐在椅子上。

    他注视着镜中那帅气的脸庞，嘴角挂着一抹无奈的微笑。

    原本以为是天胡开局，没想到是天崩开局。

    我就说嘛，哪有大四学生一开始就能接到男主角的。

    除非像董子剑那样，有个牛逼的老娘。

    现在想来，原身肯定被骗了，稀里糊涂签了合同，然后沾沾自喜，做着能成为大明星的美梦。

    谁成想，他才是被宰的羔羊。

    仔细回想了下前几天的拍摄内容，魏沐愈发觉得处处透着不对劲。

    想到这里，他松了口气，幸好没有拍实质性的内容，要不然就没脸见人了。

    其实被骗出演爱情动作片的明星不少，毕竟八九十年代的香江盛产这种电影。

    魏沐不才，前世曾经做过这类专题，专门盘点了那些被骗的演员。

    比较有名的是张国容，他当年还在歌手圈里打转，第一次被人邀请拍电影，说是拍《红楼梦》题材的电影。

    《红楼梦》，四大名著哎！！

    张国容一听就答应了。

    他当时并没有太多选择，毕竟那个时候才七十年代末，还不是谭张争霸的时代。

    结果签完合同，进了片场，才发现是《红楼梦》题材的叁级片。

    想反悔但是没用，因为已经签了合同，而且这是吴斯远的项目.....

    与他命运相同的还有吴启华，就是《九品芝麻官》里那个贱贱的状师“方唐镜”

    这哥们更惨，开始只是尝试事业转型，但却是被骗接演了《玉***团之****》《满***酷*刑》等香江情色片。

    关键是，他那个时候已经有了老婆孩子。

    唉....

    想到这里，魏沐对着镜子中的大帅比深深叹了口气。

    这些明星在出演叁级片之前已经有了代表作。

    哪像他？出道即巅峰！！

    本来以为凭借自己这副吊炸天的颜值和身体，再加上对娱乐圈未来数十年的了解，能够赚票子买房子泡妹子。

    没想到遇到这种事情。

    一念及此，魏沐微微抬头，看向镜子里的自己，眼神变得坚定。

    好不容易穿过来，不能死在这上面。

    他走过去，拉开房门，看了外面戴眼镜的光头中年人一眼，这是剧组的导演。

    昨天还笑容满面的导演，现在已经换了一副面孔，他眉头紧锁，瞪眼说道，“你在做什么？”

    “我不干了。”，魏沐很直接的说道。

    导演眼睛瞪得更大了，似乎听不懂魏沐的话，“你在说什么？”

    “我说...我不干了。”

    导演先是嘴角一抽，然后冷笑道，“你知不知道我们已经签了合同。”

    显然，他对这种情况有所预料，一开口就提起了合同。

    “你们骗我，这明明是叁级片”

    “你在说什么？我们这是武侠电影，正经片。”，听到这番话，对面的男人推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，一本正经的说道。

    眼看导演还在狡辩，魏沐直接冲出去，指着在片场等待的女演员。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Bang!Bang!Bang——

A rapid knock on the door sounded in my ears, and then a man's urging voice came through the door, "Pretty boy, what are you doing? The whole crew is waiting for you."

But Wei Mu, who was urged, slumped on the chair helplessly.

He stared at the handsome face in the mirror, with a helpless smile hanging on the corner of his mouth.

I originally thought it was Tianhu’s start, but I didn’t expect it was Tianbeng’s start.

Let me tell you, no senior student can get the leading role from the very beginning.

Unless, like Dong Zijian, you have an awesome old lady.

Thinking about it now, the original person must have been deceived, signed the contract in a daze, and then was complacent, dreaming of becoming a big star.

Whoever realizes this will be the lamb to be slaughtered.

After carefully recalling the shooting content of the past few days, Wei Mu felt more and more that something was wrong everywhere.

Thinking of this, he breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, he didn’t shoot any substantive content, otherwise he would have been embarrassed to see people.

In fact, there are many stars who have been deceived into starring in love action movies. After all, Hong Kong was rich in such movies in the 1980s and 1990s.

Wei Mu is not talented. In his previous life, he had done this kind of special topic, specifically counting the actors who were deceived.

The more famous one is Zhang Guorong. He was still in the singer circle at that time. He was invited to make a movie for the first time, saying that it was to make a movie with the theme of "Dream of Red Mansions".

"A Dream of Red Mansions", one of the four great classics!!

Zhang Guorong agreed as soon as he heard it.

He didn’t have many choices at the time. After all, it was only the late 1970s, and it was not the era of Tan and Zhang competing for hegemony.

After signing the contract and entering the studio, I found out that it was a third-level film based on "Dream of Red Mansions".

I wanted to regret it but it was useless because the contract had already been signed and this was Wu Siyuan’s project...

With the same fate as him, Wu Qihua is the mean lawyer "Fang Tangjing" in "The Nine-Rank Sesame Official"

This guy is even worse. He was just trying to change his career at first, but he was deceived into taking roles in Hong Kong pornographic films such as "The Jade Corps" and "Manchurian Torture".

The key is that he already had a wife and children at that time.



Thinking of this, Wei Mu sighed deeply at the handsome man in the mirror.

These stars already had masterpieces before appearing in C-level films.

How does it look like him?The debut is the peak!!

I originally thought that with my amazing looks and body, coupled with my knowledge of the entertainment industry for the next few decades, I could earn enough money to buy a house and pick up girls.

I didn’t expect to encounter such a thing.

When thinking of this, Wei Mu raised his head slightly and looked at himself in the mirror, his eyes becoming firm.

​​It’s hard to get through, you can’t die here.

He walked over, opened the door, and glanced at the bald middle-aged man wearing glasses outside. He was the director of the crew.

The director who was still smiling yesterday has now changed his face. He frowned and said with a glare, "What are you doing?"

"I quit." Wei Mu said directly.

The director’s eyes widened even more, as if he couldn’t understand Wei Mu’s words, “What are you talking about?”

"I said...I quit."

The director twitched his lips first, and then sneered, "Do you know we have already signed a contract?"

“Obviously, he had anticipated this situation and raised the contract as soon as he opened his mouth.

"You lied to me, this is obviously a third-level film"

"What are you talking about? This is a martial arts movie, a serious movie." After hearing these words, the man opposite pushed up the glasses on the bridge of his nose and said seriously.

Seeing that the director was still quibbling, Wei Mu rushed out and pointed at the actress waiting on the set.
